title: NY school changes policy after student suspended for bringing coffee to class
summary: A school district in Upstate New York (Beaver River Central School District) modified its classroom food and beverage policy following public pressure over a student suspension for bringing coffee to class. The new policy empowers teachers to make case-by-case decisions on outside food and drinks rather than enforcing a blanket ban, representing a shift toward flexible, discretionary policy implementation.

political_signal.description: Public hearing and community reaction prompted school board to reconsider and reverse an inflexible policy, demonstrating responsiveness to constituent concerns.
